name: Math Studio
author: Code Fry Dev
description: Interactive mathematics studio, symbolic CAS, and conceptual visual learning laboratory for FryWorld.
releaseNotes: Initial release of FryMath Studio: interactive 2D calculus canvas with live Math Probe, matrix transformation grid morpher, Fourier epicycle and wave synthesizer with audio, Galton board normal distribution simulator, and Wolfram-style multi-pod solver.

AudioVolume.description: Output volume multiplier for harmonic wave synthesis audio playback.
